Putting the value of $x = \frac{80}{9}$ in equation (1), we get

$$\frac{1}{5} \cdot \frac{80}{9} + \frac{3}{y} = 3$$

or, $$\frac{11}{9} + \frac{3}{y} = 3$$

$$\therefore \frac{3}{y} = 3 - \frac{16}{9}$$

or, $$\frac{3}{y} = \frac{27 - 16}{9}$$

or, $$\frac{3}{y} = \frac{11}{9}$$

$$\therefore \frac{1}{y} = \frac{11}{27}$$

$$\therefore y = \frac{27}{11}$$

$$\therefore \text{Required solution is } (x, y) = (\frac{80}{9}, \frac{27}{11})$$
